arguments.message: Reese planning proposal: prioritize all STRICT meetings full-window with no conflicts: m001 [1,2), m008 [9,10), m016 [10,11), m010 [11,12). For SOFT meetings, to avoid overlap penalties, I’m considering a non-overlapping chain that still gives broad coordination chances: m003 [0,1), m002 [2,3), m004 [3,4), m015 [4,5), m013 [5,7), m009 [7,9), m011 skip (conflicts with strict at 9), m005 [12,14), and likely skip m006/m012 because they overlap m002/m004. If others can align with these slots, we can create overlap without self-conflict. Feedback welcome, especially from Quinn/Jordan/Riley/Taylor/Avery on shared soft meetings.

Riley planning: I agree we should definitely cover STRICT meetings m008 [9,10) and m016 [10,11) in full. For SOFT meetings, to avoid self-overlap penalties, my tentative chain is m003 [0,1), m012 [2,4) OR m006 [2,3), m015 [4,5), m009 [7,9), then m005 [12,14). Key question is the [2,4) block: since m002 [0,4), m006 [2,5), and m012 [2,4) all conflict, I’d prefer we concentrate on one of m012 or m006 rather than spread out. My slight preference is m012 [2,4) because it gives 2 slots of overlap if several of us align. Also I would skip m011 because of conflict with m008 at [9,10), and likely skip m007 because it conflicts with strict m016 and with m005. If others can signal preferred common slots, I can align.

Quinn planning proposal: I support taking all STRICT meetings full-window: m001 [1,2), m008 [9,10), m016 [10,11), m010 [11,12). For SOFT meetings, to avoid self-overlap penalties, my tentative non-overlapping chain is m003 [0,1), then one coordinated choice in the [2,4) cluster—my preference is m012 [2,4) rather than splitting across m002/m006/m014—then m015 [4,5), m013 [5,7), m009 [7,9), skip m011 due to conflict with m008, and m005 [12,14). I’d likely skip m007 because [10,13) conflicts with m016/m010 and m005. If others agree, we can concentrate overlap on m003, m012, m015, m013, m009, m005 plus all stricts. Also note m004 [3,5) conflicts with both m012 and m015, so I’d skip m004 if we choose this chain.

My preference among the early conflicts is m012 [2,4) as the main shared choice, then m015 [4,5), m013 [5,7), m009 [7,9). I would skip m002, m004, m006, m014 to avoid overlap/splitting, and skip m011 because it conflicts with m008 at [9,10). For late softs, I expect to skip m007 because it conflicts with m016/m010. So my tentative Jordan plan is: m001 [1,2), m012 [2,4), m015 [4,5), m013 [5,7), m009 [7,9), m008 [9,10), m016 [10,11), m010 [11,12), with the other Jordan meetings skipped. If others can align on this, it seems strong and conflict-free.
